query: After switching themes everything recolored except my open Qt app (it's a Kvantum app). The colors on disk look updated. Did the theme switch fail?
expected_behavior: Explains the switch did NOT fail — Qt/Kvantum themes and Qt6 icon themes update on disk (kvantummanager --set / qt6ct.conf) but running Qt processes don't reload them, so a restart of the app is required
Contrasts with what DOES live-recolor (foot via OSC, sway borders via swaymsg reload, GTK via gsettings, eww via filesystem watch) and notes cursor theme applies to newly launched apps only
Points to man palette-theming for the full per-feature behavior
notes: Guards against diagnosing a 'failed' theme switch when the real behavior is documented: Qt/Kvantum can't hot-reload a running process. A naive answer might re-run the theme script or hunt for a bug instead of just restarting the Qt app.
